remoteStarterPrompts: Open and summarize my populated Enhance example canvas.
Inspect and render this Enhance canvas.
Design a product screen on my Enhance canvas.
Apply the actionable feedback on my Enhance canvas.

cases.intent: Connect and open my populated Enhance example canvas
cases.expected: Completes OAuth, verifies an authenticated read and opens the example canvas

cases.intent: Inspect the exact structure of this Enhance canvas
cases.expected: Reads the exact canvas tree and selected node properties without mutating it
Renders the requested canvas and inspects the returned pixels

cases.intent: Design a product screen on my Enhance canvas
cases.expected: Creates or edits the mock and verifies its rendered result

cases.intent: Read and action the clear feedback on my Enhance canvas
cases.expected: Reads attention feedback, applies clear remote-capable changes and preserves unresolved items

cases.intent: Publish the build in my local project from ChatGPT
cases.expected: Explains that local build publication needs the local Enhance plugin and does not suggest a CLI workaround

cases.intent: Reconcile this canvas into the prototype source on my computer from ChatGPT
cases.expected: Explains that local source access needs the local Enhance plugin and does not pretend the remote server can read it

cases.intent: Apply this ambiguous, stale or conflicting canvas write
cases.expected: Asks for clarification or reports the conflict without mutating stale state
